summary: End-to-end testing of new Veli (Parent) role. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering parent login, /api/veli/* endpoints, authorization guards (parent->admin 403, admin->veli 403, teacher->veli 403, cross-student 403), student creation with parent (incl. duplicate-username, missing-password validation) and /api/auth/register parent flow (empty linked_student_ids rejected). Frontend E2E: admin + teacher login regressions pass; Admin > Yeni Öğrenci shows Veli Giriş Bilgileri with create-parent-checkbox toggling veli-username/password fields; Admin > Kullanıcı Yönetimi user-type-select has 'Veli' option, parent-student-multiselect appears, 'Veli için en az bir öğrenci seçmelisiniz' error toast shown when saving with 0 students; parent login redirects to /veli; Veli Paneli menu (Ana Sayfa/Dersler/Ödemeler) and all three screens render correctly with status badges (Borçlu/Bakiye Mevcut), Birebir/Grup ders tipi, branch filter, payment total; VeliStudentSelector correctly hidden for single-student parent (veli_test).

integration_issues.issue: When a logged-in parent navigates directly to /admin or /teacher, URL stays on that path and React Router logs 'No routes matched location'. No admin/teacher content is rendered (security OK), but ProtectedRoute does not redirect because /admin/* and /teacher/* routes are only mounted inside role-specific branches of App.js. Add a catch-all redirect in App.js for authenticated users (e.g. a <Route path='*'> that routes to /veli for parent, /admin/dashboard for admin, etc.) for cleaner UX.

action_items: Optional UX polish: add catch-all route in App.js so a parent hitting /admin or /teacher is redirected to /veli (currently URL remains but nothing renders).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >11,000 lines — split by domain modules (auth, students, veli, payments, lessons) for maintainability.
Backend returns status 'borclu'/'alacakli' (lowercase, legacy) and the frontend maps to 'Borçlu'/'Bakiye Mevcut'. Consider aligning backend values with product spec to avoid double-mapping drift.
DELETE /api/students removes the linked parent user when they have no other students — good; make sure cascading audit log entries are written.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; minor route-guard polish)
